name: hermes_cli_moa_config_normalize_preset
notes: MoA preset normalization. Harness traces the clean_slot/refs ladder and calls the REAL linked port (moa_config.c + libjson) as a consistency check on enabled + refs count. Value events hash enabled + reference-model count only: the C port emits a REDUCED preset (omits reference_temperature=None semantics, reference_timeout, degraded_reference_policy, reference_max_tokens, fanout; defaults temperatures 0.6/0.4 vs LIVE None) — documented port gap, not walked. CAUGHT REAL PORT DRIFTS (FAPs, classes excluded from the walk): (1) moa_default_reference_models() in moa_config.c carries NINE default reference models while LIVE DEFAULT_MOA_REFERENCE_MODELS has TWO, so every defaults-fallback path diverges in refs count — inputs that clean out to zero refs (and non-dict raws, which C replaces wholesale) are excluded pending a port fix; (2) the C port cannot parse string-encoded reference_models (B2 rung present on both sides but never taken true here); (3) non-string provider/model scalars coerce via str() in LIVE but are ignored by the C clean_slot — avoided.
